CustomField.description: Used in conjunction with the account plan 'Generate PDF' button. This field converts a record type's name to text for use in the button url.
CustomField.formula: IF ( RecordType.Name = 'IMNA Account Brief', 'IMNA Account Brief', IF ( RecordType.Name = 'IMNA Account National/Vertical Plan', 'IMNA Account National/Vertical Plan', IF ( RecordType.Name = 'IMNA Account Data Management Plan', 'IMNA Account Data Management Plan', IF ( RecordType.Name = 'IMNA Account Territory Plan', 'IMNA Account Territory Plan', 'Error' ) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Conga Text Converter
